name: skill-trace
description: Side pane: per question, the skills Claude chose and why, plus the MCP tools, subagents, hooks and slash commands it used.

start.title: Open at start
start.description: on: the 스킬 추적 pane opens when a session starts. off: it stays closed until you run /skill-trace.

reason.title: Ask for reasons
reason.description: on: Claude writes a one-line `[스킬근거] <skill>: <reason>` before each Skill call, and the pane shows it. off: no rule is added and no such lines appear in chat; skills show 이유 미기재.
